name: Can outdoor kitchens be covered or roofed?

mainEntity.name: Can outdoor kitchens be covered or roofed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, pergolas, ramadas, or solid roofs with skylights provide shade and rain protection; permits required for enclosed structures over 10 ft tall or attached to house.
